evidence: USGS (older): bare farmland and scrub, no buildings. ESRI (newer): TWO COMPLETE halls with rows of ground-level equipment along both long facades, plus a third hall still going up and an on-site switchyard. The pair raw-land -> operating-halls shows the site was built between captures, and the ground-level equipment is what this model requires.
verdict_note: IN SCOPE. Note the OSM tag on the receptor is building=construction and is therefore STALE -- traced during the build. The imagery is the better evidence and it contradicts the tag; recorded so nobody re-refuses this site on the tag alone. Single-assessor reading, unit type inferred from placement not certified.
limits: Single-source reading at 0. Chillers and generators are not distinguishable at this resolution, so 'ground-level plant' is a statement about WHERE the equipment is, not about what it is. The two-source cross-check is NOT met -- the same weaker standing this project records for Dulles.
